answer_1.quote: We propose to leverage the unified semantic graph to improve the performance of neural abstractive models for long-document summarization and MDS.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of generated summaries using ROUGE F1 ... We also report BERTScore F1, a better metric at evaluating semantic similarity between system summaries and reference summaries.

answer_4.quote: We invite 2 annotators to assess the summaries of different models independently. Annotators evaluate the overall quality of summaries by ranking them taking into account the following criterias: (1) Informativeness... (2) Fluency... (3) Succinctness...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank system outputs based on informativeness, fluency, and succinctness, assigning scores 2,1,-1,2 for rankings 1-4 respectively.
